html:
If you own a real estate agency in Mexico, you know exactly what I'm talking about: WhatsApp never stops ringing. Prospects asking about prices, locations, availability... at 11 PM, on Sundays, in the middle of your vacation.

The question is no longer whether you should automate your WhatsApp. The question is why you haven't done it yet.

📊 Real data: An average real estate agency in Mexico receives between 40 and 120 WhatsApp messages per day. A human agent can handle a maximum of 30–40 simultaneous quality conversations. The rest are lost — or answered late.

What is an AI Chatbot for WhatsApp in Real Estate?

We're not talking about a menu bot with buttons (that's 2018 technology). An AI chatbot for real estate is an artificial intelligence agent specifically trained on your catalog, your areas, your prices, and your sales processes.

It can do all this alone, 24 hours a day, without rest:

  • Answer questions about available properties
  • Filter prospects by budget, area, and property type
  • Schedule appointments directly in the agent's calendar
  • Send technical sheets, photos, and videos of properties
  • Automatically follow up with prospects who didn't respond
  • Pre-qualify for mortgage credit with 20+ questions

Real Case: Real Estate Agency in Torreón

Miguel R., director of a real estate agency in Torreón, Coahuila, had 300+ messages/day and 2 support staff responding manually. Average response time: 47 minutes. Conversion rate to appointment: 8%.

After implementing the AI agent with GH Specialist:

  • First response time: 3 seconds
  • Simultaneous attention: unlimited
  • Conversion rate to appointment: 24% (3x more)
  • Extra monthly payroll cost: $0

💡 ROI was in 6 weeks. The chatbot cost $12,000 MXN + IVA. The 2 support employees cost $18,000/month. The decision was mathematical.

Prices vary greatly depending on the provider and complexity. At GH Specialist, we offer the AI chatbot service for WhatsApp with these options:

  • Basic Chatbot: $12,000 MXN + IVA (one-time payment)
  • Omnichannel Agent: $35,000 MXN + IVA (WhatsApp + Instagram + Web + CRM)

Compare that with the cost of a single customer service employee: $8,000–$15,000/month. The chatbot pays for itself in 1–3 months.

CRM Integration: The Winning Combo

The chatbot alone is powerful. The chatbot connected to a CRM like Kommo is unstoppable. Every prospect who talks to the bot automatically enters the sales pipeline, with their name, interests, budget, and stage of the process.

Your sales team no longer chases cold leads — they only receive qualified leads ready to close.
